Property.Name: IsClearHitList
Property.Description: Whether to clear all hit count calculations. If false, any hits called by this action will count towards the first called "MultiHitLimit" with a valid number.

Property.Name: MultiHitLimit
Property.Description: Creates an FSM-wide hit count maximum. Any actions with "IsClearHitList" set to true will void previous calls. Actions set to "IsHitOnce" do not count to the total.

Property.Name: DebuffList

Property.Description: Amount of SBA gauge to gain for the attack on a per hit basis. Affected by Uplift and in-game multipliers

Property.Name: HitStopSecond
Property.Description: Amount of time, in seconds, for the game to create "Hitstop" when the attack lands.

Property.Name: LifeSecond
Property.Description: Amount of time, in seconds, that a hitbox will remain active for. Not sure if an FSM can call multiple hitboxes at the same time, or if the most recent will override.
